name: Datavault AI Inc.

profile.description: Datavault AI offers data tokenization, monetization and IP licensing platforms, expanded through acquisitions (CSI, API Media). Q2 2026 revenue was $6.72M (+287% YoY) against a net loss of $88M.

innovation.label: WEAK
innovation.analysis: Track Record (1/3): Repositioned toward tokenization and data monetization, still early. AI Deployment (1/2): AI and tokenization products announced, but no quantified savings. Market Share (0/2): No category leadership. Pipeline (1/2): $200M 2026 revenue target is stated but contrasts with Q1-Q2 revenue of just $10.1M combined [1]. R&D Intensity (0/1): No evidence of above-peer R&D.

inspiration.label: WEAK
inspiration.analysis: Mission Floor (1/4): Generic data-monetization positioning. Community (0/2), Employee Retention (0/2): Glassdoor describes a culture of confusion, fear and retaliation [2]. Insider Buying (0/2): No net insider buying evidence found.

infrastructure.label: DEVELOPING
infrastructure.analysis: Growth sleeve, mechanical. D/E 3.9% (1.0), ROE -108% (0.0, 2x), revenue growth 287% (1.0), profit margin deeply negative (0.0). Forward P/E 1.1 from yfinance judged unreliable given an $88M quarterly loss and excluded; 5yr CAGR and PEG unavailable. Weighted 2.0 of 5 gives 4. Dollar volume of about $6M clears the liquidity floor [1].

ai_resilience.label: HIGH RISK
ai_resilience.analysis: AI Risk Protection (3/9): A micro-cap in data and software tokenization faces competition from larger platforms and AI tools; growth is acquisition-driven and unproven [1]. AI Opportunity (0/1): Reported revenue stems mainly from acquisitions and patent licensing, not demonstrated AI products.

infinite_game.summary: Datavault AI chases quarter-to-quarter narrative with aggressive revenue targets, serial acquisitions and an unstable organization, which is the finite pattern Sinek warns against.

just_cause.analysis: Just Cause (0/3): No articulated cause beyond data monetization and growth [1].

trusting_teams.analysis: Trusting Teams (0/2): Glassdoor cites fear, retaliation and reactive leadership [2].

worthy_rivals.analysis: Worthy Rivals (0/1): No evidence of an infinite competitive mindset.

existential_flexibility.analysis: Existential Flexibility (1/2): Has changed business model repeatedly, though not clearly in service of a cause [1].

courage_to_lead.analysis: Courage to Lead (0/2): No costly principled decisions; a $200M target was reiterated against a Q2 revenue miss [1].

investment_thesis: Datavault AI is growing revenue quickly from a tiny base ($6.72M in Q2 2026, +287%) via acquisitions and patent license sales, and management targets $200M for 2026 [1]. D/E is just 3.9% and the tokenization platform gives optionality if partner deals convert.
thesis_continued: The bear case is severe: Q2 net loss was $88M against $2.9M gross profit and $29.3M opex, and the Q2 revenue miss weighed on shares against a $200M target that needs about $190M over the remaining two quarters [1]. At $0.15 with 40M daily shares, dilution and Nasdaq listing risk are high, and Glassdoor reports a fear-driven culture [2]. The Inspire score of 0 is uninformative.
key_catalysts: Closing partner tokenization and data-monetization deals to approach the $200M target [1]
Contribution from acquired CSI and API Media revenue [1]
Patent licensing sales continuing to scale [1]
key_risks: Net loss of $88M in Q2 2026 on $6.7M revenue; dilution and financing dependence [1]
Revenue target credibility: $10.1M in H1 against $200M goal [1]
Leadership instability and fear-based culture reports [2]
sources: Datavault AI Q1 and Q2 2026 results, Nasdaq/StockTitan/Investing.com, 2026
Glassdoor DataVault reviews; Simply Wall St management analysis, 2026
